mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name FROM books b LEFT JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (isbn, title, author, publisher, category_id, total_count, available_count, description, cover_image) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{categoryId}, #{totalCount}, #{availableCount}, #{description}, #{coverImage})
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET isbn = #{isbn}, title = #{title}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, category_id = #{categoryId}, total_count = #{totalCount}, description = #{description}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE books SET available_count = available_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
